# Music Japan LLC — Japan Travel Planning

> Music Japan LLC is a registered Japanese company that builds custom, day-by-day Japan itineraries in English, planned by a team that lives in Japan.

## Key facts
- Starter Itinerary: $99 for a complete 3-day, day-by-day itinerary in English
- Full Trip Planning: $499 for your entire trip planned, plus bookings handled in Japanese
- Not included: flights, hotels, meals, and local transport costs (planning and booking arrangements only)
- This is itinerary design and booking help, not a guided tour — no one travels with you
- Common starting points: Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka; trips are built from scratch for each traveler
